plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says an engineer named John Norsine holds a locked patent, one kept secret by the government, for essentially flying a UFO with your mind. In a later episode he says the patents, tied to the aerospace company Lockheed, involve neural imprints and brain-to-machine interfaces for flying aircraft, and that Battelle, a research organisation, did a study on this in the early 2020s, which would hint that mind-controlled craft are being taken seriously if true.
